job.title: NOVA: Technology-Architecture Co-Design of Near-Memory Processing for Attention-SSM-MoE Hybrid LLM Inference
job.selection_reason: GQA/SSM/MoE混成LLMの異なる演算強度に対し、peri-dieとbase-dieの2-tier near-memory processingを割り当てるtechnology-architecture co-design。Qwen3等で平均throughput 4.5倍、end-to-end latency 69.8%削減、energy efficiency 5倍を報告し、MoEと階層near-memory executionを横断する比較価値が高い。
